description: Classify one incoming item — an e-mail (kind 'email', id from list_emails) or a messenger message (kind 'inbound_message', id from list_inbound_messages): category, priority, responsible agent and a short note. category must be one of the tenant's classification classes (without any: Anfrage, Termin, Reklamation, Rechnung, Lieferant, Bewerbung, Newsletter, Spam, Sonstiges); an unknown one is rejected with the list. priority: hoch | normal | niedrig. agent_id or agent_name names the agent who takes it over (a name is resolved in this tenant). draft_delegation_id links an existing reply draft (delegate_to_user does that itself with questions[].source). Sets triaged_at; calling it again re-classifies. Nothing is sent, moved or answered.

agent_name.description: Alternative to agent_id: the agent's name

category.description: Classification class of the tenant; unknown values are rejected with the list

draft_delegation_id.description: Delegation (from delegate_to_user) that holds the reply draft

id.description: ID of the item (from list_emails or list_inbound_messages)

kind.description: Type of item to classify: e-mail or messenger message

note.description: Why / what to do next (max 2000 characters)

name: classify_message
